name: SensorMonitor component test plan
deployment: PiSensor full system deployment plus the harness component sysTester, prototype image (TCP); the project's test configuration is supplied by campaign fvp-2026-11-17-1 with the DEVELOPMENT stretch

not_covered_ack: Limit, future-time and start-up branches (REQ-SensorMonitor-004, -006, -007, -008): unit tests cover them; not plantable on the bench.
Identity read with a wrong value, and bus statuses other than the one an unpowered device gives: unit tests cover them; the bench line removes the supply only.
coverage.rationale: Baselines of the skill. The unit tests drive every port of the passive component on the host, so 95 % lines is reachable; the bench cannot force out-of-limit readings or a wrong identity value, so the on-target figure stays at the 75 % baseline.

final_state.accepted_evidence: the last sentence of the bench GPS script as sent (bench-actions.log, copied after the run into record/raw/final-state.txt), compared by the auditor with the Latitude, Longitude and Altitude samples of the L7-1 window
final_state.rationale: The component keeps no stored state; its final state is what it publishes. The bench owns the sentence script, so the comparison lies outside the UUT's reporting path and fails when the component reports a location the bench did not send. The i2cget of register 0x75 in the same file is a bench health fact, not the independent check.

REQ-SensorMonitor-003.note: the 0.1 degree bound is below the noise of the 10 Hz pairing on the bench; L2-1 and L2-2 judge the angles within a noise allowance; unit test UT-03 is the verification of record

REQ-SensorMonitor-004.note: start-up state before a first reading cannot be held on the bench

REQ-SensorMonitor-006.note: a reading time ahead of the clock needs a clock step, not plantable on a shared bench

REQ-SensorMonitor-007.note: start-up state; a sensor absent at boot needs a restart of the shared deployment per sensor

REQ-SensorMonitor-008.note: a sensor that answers with out-of-limit data is not plantable (project plan, not covered)

REQ-SensorMonitor-017.note: once, in order, unchanged cannot be judged through a 1 Hz telemetry flush; unit test UT-23; the system effect (location follows the sentences) is judged by location_equals_script in L2-1 and L7-1

REQ-SensorMonitor-018.note: the request port is driven by productManager; its system tests are the project's L2-3 to L2-6 and L5-9, L5-10

REQ-SensorMonitor-019.note: as REQ-SensorMonitor-018; the age boundary is a unit test

REQ-SensorMonitor-020.note: Inspection of the FPP port kinds and the guard

scope: L0: desk-checked; bench confirmation pending. Marker `sysTester.MARK(U32)` -> event `sysTester.Marker(id)`, as in the project plan (`SystemTester/test/int/plan.json`). Event rate of this plan, from the pinned sources: worst one-second burst 13 events = `MARK` (Marker + 2 cmdDisp events) + `BENCH_LINE` (2 cmdDisp events) + up to 5 throttled manager warnings (`BmpManager.fpp` events with `throttle 5` at 10 Hz, or `imuManager.I2cError`) + 1 loss event + up to 2 `gpsManager` warnings (1 Hz sentences, `throttle 5`); over any 10 s window at most 20 events, 2 per second on average. The burst is above the project plan's figure of 5 events per second in any window: reported to the project campaign; the bench check at L0 replaces this estimate. The 19 component channels at 1 Hz add 7 channels of 1 byte to the project's Table 1 telemetry [I].
- UUT: component `PiSensor.SensorMonitor`, instance `sensorMonitor`, in the PiSensor deployment on the Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee`, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13.

- Test deployment: the project's full deployment plus `sysTester` (SSDD decision D13, pending the human's ruling at Approve SSDD), prototype image over TCP; ground system fprime-yamcs at the project pin. Fallback if D13 is refused: the base deployment (`deploy/base`, which already carries `sysTester`) plus `sensorMonitor`.

- Stimuli: `sysTester.MARK(id)`; `sysTester.BENCH_LINE(line, state)` with `line` in {BMP280, MPU6050} and `state` in {OFF, ON} (signature of the project plan; the command is not in `SystemTester.fpp` at the base deployment yet). The GPS sentence source is on the workstation and is driven by bench actions only (stop, resume, sentence content from `bench/gps-script.nmea`), each logged with bench time in bench-actions.log. The tilt of L2-2 is a bench action.

- Pairing rule for the Reading comparisons: each component sample is paired with the manager `Reading` sample nearest in FSW time; the managers run at 10 Hz and the telemetry flush at 1 Hz, so the pair can be two different 10 Hz samples and the bounds are noise allowances; a component sample with no `Reading` sample within 1.5 s is unpaired and does not count towards the minimum pair count.
- Out of scope: data product content (campaign `prodmgr` and the project plan), downlink period at the ground (project L2-1), RFM69 link (project flight block).
entry_gates: - Unit tests of `SensorMonitor` pass with the plan's coverage; the project's deployment with `sensorMonitor` wired builds from the manifest SHAs.

- L0-1 passes on the bench; marker round-trip, event rate and the noise allowances of L2-1 and L2-2 confirmed (replaces the desk check): the rate of mismatched 10 Hz pairs is recorded and each allowance is set for a false-failure probability of at most 1e-3 per window; the ground rendering of the enum arguments of `Mpu6050Lost` (bare or qualified name) is confirmed against the event pattern.
- `sysTester.BENCH_LINE(line, state)` exists in the harness model with the argument names and enum values above; the planted-fault functions are re-verified against it (`fth verify-plan --tests`).

- Bench recipe of the project plan: bench lines BMP280 and MPU6050 (supply switches, I2C isolated), GPS sentence source on the GPS UART in place of the receiver, with `bench/gps-script.nmea` pinned in the manifest.

- Between tests the harness waits 20 s after the last bench line or source action; each test's `bench_ready_at_start` precondition judges the bench from the managers' channels and bench-actions.log, never from the component's own channels.
- Command times: `t(X sent)` is the FSW time of the `cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched` event of that command.
- Today's bench cannot run L2-1 to L7-1: the BMP280 and the GPS source do not answer and the bench lines are absent (project ledger).
levels: L0 provenance and feasibility · L2 functional · L5 fault paths · L7 final state. No L3 (the component keeps no state across a restart), no L4 (no endurance bound), no L6 (the component has no commands to reject).
not_covered: - REQ-SensorMonitor-003, -004, -006, -007, -008, -017, -018, -019, -020: unit test or inspection only; reasons in the requirements block.
- Wrong MPU6050 identity value with the device answering (REQ-PiSensor-043): not plantable on the bench without another device at address 0x68; unit tests UT-13.
- Identity persistence M = 3 and loss count N = 5 at their exact boundaries: unit tests; the bench tests judge a lower and an upper time bound.
- Concurrency of the five inputs under load: inspection (REQ-SensorMonitor-020); no bench stimulus forces an interleaving.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-17 designer — test deployment = the project's full deployment + `sysTester` (project decision D13, an author proposal pending the human's ruling at Approve SSDD); fallback named in the scope.
2. 2026-11-17 designer — coverage thresholds at the skill baselines (UT 95 % lines, on-target 75 % lines).
3. 2026-11-17 designer — markers, bench lines and helpers follow the project plan so one harness serves both plans; marker ids 10 to 231 are local to this plan's record.
4. 2026-11-17 designer — REQ-SensorMonitor-003 and -017 are verified by unit test of record; the bench judges their system effect within stated allowances.
5. 2026-11-17 designer — review round 1 (system-test-review Mode A, 11 must fix / 12 could fix): all accepted; dispositions in the campaign's review record.
6. 2026-11-17 designer — review round 2 (4 must fix / 3 could fix): all accepted.

7. 2026-11-17 designer — review round 3, the last of the bound (1 must fix, STR-30): accepted and closed after the round, not re-reviewed: both line-dropped faults insert their OFF command directly after the START marker. Review totals: 30 raised, 30 closed, 0 disagreements. Deferred to the bench (L0 / stage-2 refresh): marker round-trip, event rate, noise allowances, clock offset, enum rendering, the I2C_OTHER_ERR status; `sysTester.BENCH_LINE` is not in `SystemTester.fpp` yet; D13 pending.

tests.title: Sensor telemetry, all sensors present
tests.purpose: Proves every Table 1 and Table 2 channel is published each second and reads valid.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280 and MPU6050 powered, GPS sentence source sending the scripted fix sentences (quality 1) at 1 Hz. The Pi is at rest.

metrics.text: precondition: in the 3 s before the START marker bmpManager.Reading and imuManager.Reading each have a new sample and bench-actions.log shows the GPS source sending fix sentences (require; UNVERIFIED when not met; no sensorMonitor channel is read)

largest gap between FSW time tags of every Table 1 and Table 2 channel, counted from the START marker to the first sample and from the last sample to the END marker, <= 1.5 s; at least 55 samples of each channel

every sample: |Temperature - bmpManager.Reading.temperature| <= 0.5 degC and |GyroX,Y,Z - imuManager.Reading.rotation| <= 1.0 deg/s against the Reading sample nearest in FSW time and within 1.5 s (else unpaired); at least 30 pairs each

|Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 1.0 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 1.0 deg for every Roll and Pitch sample against the imuManager.Reading sample nearest in FSW time and within 1.5 s (else unpaired), Pi at rest; at least 30 pairs

every Latitude, Longitude, Altitude sample of the window equals the value of the bench sentence script (bench/gps-script.nmea, sha256 in the manifest) converted as NMEA 0183 ddmm.mmmm, within 1e-7 deg and 0.01 m; the script holds one constant position; at least 5 samples

rationale.pred: largest gap between FSW time tags of every Table 1 and Table 2 channel, counted from the START marker to the first sample and from the last sample to the END marker, <= 1.5 s; at least 55 samples of each channel
rationale.text: 1 Hz schedule call plus half a period, a test allowance for rate-group jitter confirmed at L0; FSW time tags, so the downlink does not enter; 55 = 60 s at 1 Hz less the flush phase at both markers

rationale.pred: every sample: |Temperature - bmpManager.Reading.temperature| <= 0.5 degC and |GyroX,Y,Z - imuManager.Reading.rotation| <= 1.0 deg/s against the Reading sample nearest in FSW time and within 1.5 s (else unpaired); at least 30 pairs each
rationale.text: 0.5 degC and 1.0 deg/s are noise allowances for the 10 Hz pairing race, measured at L0 and replaced at the stage-2 refresh; exact equality is unit test UT-02

rationale.pred: |Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 1.0 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 1.0 deg for every Roll and Pitch sample against the imuManager.Reading sample nearest in FSW time and within 1.5 s (else unpaired), Pi at rest; at least 30 pairs

tests.title: GPS quality indicator values
tests.purpose: Proves quality 2 and 8 read location valid and an empty indicator reads it invalid.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280 and MPU6050 powered, GPS sentence source sending the scripted fix sentences (quality 1) at 1 Hz.
procedure: action: GPS source sends GGA sentences with quality 2 at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends GGA sentences with an empty quality field at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends GGA sentences with quality 8 at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends the scripted fix sentences (quality 1) at 1 Hz

metrics.text: precondition: in the 3 s before the START marker bmpManager.Reading and imuManager.Reading each have a new sample and bench-actions.log shows the GPS source sending fix sentences (require; UNVERIFIED when not met; no sensorMonitor channel is read)

rationale.text: the catalog GPS manager publishes a Reading for every non-zero quality (GpsManager.cpp lines 45 to 49 at the pinned commit), so the reading stays fresh

tests.evidence: check: Q2: last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 2; Q2: last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID; E: last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 255; E: last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == INVALID; E: last(sensorMonitor.FixInvalidReason) == NO_FIX; Q8: last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 8; Q8: last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID; every window: ABS; every window: ABS-LOSS.

tests.title: Final state
tests.purpose: Leaves every sensor present and valid, with the location equal to the bench script.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280 and MPU6050 powered, GPS sentence source sending the scripted fix sentences (quality 1) at 1 Hz.

metrics.text: precondition: in the 3 s before the START marker bmpManager.Reading and imuManager.Reading each have a new sample and bench-actions.log shows the GPS source sending fix sentences (require; UNVERIFIED when not met; no sensorMonitor channel is read)

every Latitude, Longitude, Altitude sample of the window equals the value of the bench sentence script (bench/gps-script.nmea, sha256 in the manifest) converted as NMEA 0183 ddmm.mmmm, within 1e-7 deg and 0.01 m; the script holds one constant position; at least 5 samples

rationale.pred: every Latitude, Longitude, Altitude sample of the window equals the value of the bench sentence script (bench/gps-script.nmea, sha256 in the manifest) converted as NMEA 0183 ddmm.mmmm, within 1e-7 deg and 0.01 m; the script holds one constant position; at least 5 samples
rationale.text: the script is bench-owned evidence outside the component's reporting path; the same comparison is repeated by the auditor for the final state

tests.evidence: check: first(sensorMonitor.Bmp280State) == PRESENT; first(sensorMonitor.Mpu6050State) == PRESENT; first(sensorMonitor.GpsState) == PRESENT; first(sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid) == VALID; first(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == VALID; first(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID; last(sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid) == VALID; last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == VALID; last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID; last(sensorMonitor.TemperatureInvalidReason) == NONE; last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeInvalidReason) == NONE; last(sensorMonitor.FixInvalidReason) == NONE; last(sensorMonitor.Bmp280State) == PRESENT; last(sensorMonitor.Mpu6050State) == PRESENT; last(sensorMonitor.GpsState) == PRESENT; last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 1; ABS; ABS-LOSS; ABS-MGR. After the run the bench copies the last sentence the source sent (bench-actions.log) and reads MPU6050 register 0x75 (`i2cget -y 1 0x68 0x75`, a bench health fact) into record/raw/final-state.txt.
